description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament 1+1 per shitje ne nje komplekset me elitare dhe te preferuar per banim ne Tirane.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e kater, te nje prej objekteve te kompleksit, i organizuar ne hapesira te bollshme e te mire shfrytezuara, ne nje sallon ndenje me ambjent gatimi, dhome gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon me orientim totalisht jug.
Nje mundesi shume e mire per te jetuar ne nje zone prane te gjithe fasiliteteve publike dhe private.
Apartamenti dispponon certifikate pronesie,
Per me teper informacion me kontaktoni.
description_en: We offer a 1+1 apartment for sale in one of the most elite and preferred residential complexes in Tirana. The apartment is located on the fourth floor, of one of the buildings of the complex, organized in spacious and well-utilized spaces, in a living room with a kitchen area, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony with a total south orientation. A very good opportunity to live in an area near all public and private facilities. The apartment has ownership certificates, contact me for more information.
